𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗲𝗱 𝗠𝘆 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗮𝘁 𝗗𝗦𝗔 𝗟𝗲𝗴𝗮𝗹

In October 2026, I interned with the General Corporate Team at DSA LEGAL. Over four weeks, I progressed from understanding pleadings to drafting them and researching case law for corporate and commercial matters
I worked on arbitration, banking and finance, consumer, commercial, and property matters. I drafted written statements, interim applications and replies, and applications under Order I Rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure. Learning from my associates every day was a real highlight, and I am truly grateful for that exposure.

I am deeply thankful to Anurya Sabharwal sir and Deepak Sabharwal sir for their kind support and for giving me the chance to contribute to their team. It meant a lot to me.
 
One of the most memorable parts of my internship was visiting the Delhi International Arbitration Centre (DIAC) with Abhinit Das sir and Isha Dabas mam for an arbitration matter. Seeing the proceedings first-hand, including how an arbitration hearing is run and how cross-examination is conducted, taught me far more than any textbook could. I am thankful to both of them for taking me along and for the learning that came with it.
 
I owe my deepest gratitude to Adv. Gauri Dua mam, my assigned associate. She guided me through every task with remarkable patience, took the time to explain what I did not understand, I will always be grateful for the time and trust she gave me.
I am sincerely thankful to Ipshita Pandey mam, Meetu Kumari Kumari mam, VANSHIKA CHUGH mam and Ayushi Kashyap mam for their guidance, patience, and the knowledge they so generously shared with me throughout the month. I am also thankful to Nirbhay Ahuja sir for taking me along to GNIDA. It was a wonderful experience and gave me a first-hand look at how matters are handled 

My sincere thanks to Utkarsh Lohra sir, Aryan Shakya sir, Harshit Yadav sir, Nayan Yadav Yadav, for keeping the office both professional and relaxed. Thank you for your guidance and encouragement, and for making the office such a welcoming place to learn. I am fortunate to have worked alongside such capable and supportive people.

Thank you to the entire DSA LEGAL Legal team for your kind support and warm gestures throughout. Grateful for every moment, and I hope our paths cross again.
